item.title: Morning News Brief
item.description: Pentagon sees continued exodus of senior military leaders; Trump's Venezuela oil deal faces legal scrutiny; jury remains deadlocked in ongoing trial.

item.title: Loss of SNAP benefits threatens free school meal programs for millions of children
item.description: Reductions in food stamp enrollment are impacting access to school breakfast and lunch, according to experts observing early effects.

item.title: Former FEMA head says Trump administration reversed course on agency elimination
item.description: David Richardson, who led FEMA last year, had sought to dismantle the agency. He now says the administration has dropped that effort.

item.title: Xi's Egypt visit signals China's expanding Middle East role
item.description: Chinese President Xi Jinping makes his first trip to Egypt in a decade, highlighting Beijing's growing regional ambitions as U.S. influence wanes.
